snippet.title: MINECRAFT’S VISUAL REFRESH!
snippet.description:
Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual refresh. Coming initially to Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, join the Mojang developers as they discuss the vision behind this visual overhaul, the road to getting it ready for Bedrock Edition, and what’s coming next!

Find out more (general info) https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-vibrant-visuals
Find out more for java (https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/vibrant-visuals-java-edition

Vibrant Visuals requires Minecraft: Bedrock Edition and supported device. Coming in the future for Minecraft: Java Edition. All sold separately. At launch, some Marketplace content won't be compatible with Vibrant Visuals.
